steps.script: (() => { for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('.database-table-body-scroll, .database-table-header-scroll, [class*=scroll]')) { if (el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth) el.scrollLeft = el.scrollWidth; } })()

(() => { const menus = [...document.querySelectorAll('.database-column-editor')].filter((el) => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0; }); menus.at(-1)?.setAttribute('data-parity-menu', ''); })()
